parameters.formDescription: Set up and schedule an email marketing campaign

values.placeholder: Text that appears in inbox preview

options.formSubmittedText: Your campaign has been created and scheduled!

parameters.jsCode:
// Parse campaign request
const input = $input.first().json;

const campaign = {
  id: `camp_${Date.now()}`,
  name: input['Campaign Name'] || input.name || 'Untitled Campaign',
  subject: input['Email Subject'] || input.subject || '',
  previewText: input['Preview Text'] || input.previewText || '',
  fromName: input['From Name'] || input.fromName || 'Your Company',
  fromEmail: input['From Email'] || input.fromEmail || 'hello@company.com',
  replyTo: input['Reply-To Email'] || input.replyTo || '',
  esp: input['Email Service Provider'] || input.esp || 'Mailchimp',
  audience: input['Audience/List'] || input.audience || 'All Subscribers',
  customSegmentId: input['Custom Segment ID (if applicable)'] || input.customSegmentId || '',
  campaignType: input['Campaign Type'] || input.campaignType || 'Newsletter',
  body: input['Email Body (HTML or Text)'] || input.body || '',
  ctaUrl: input['Call to Action URL'] || input.ctaUrl || '',
  sendTime: input['Send Time'] || 'Send Now',
  scheduledTime: input['Scheduled Date/Time'] || input.scheduledTime || '',
  abTest: input['A/B Test'] || 'No A/B Test',
  abVariant: input['A/B Variant (if testing)'] || input.abVariant || '',
  aiPersonalization: input['AI Personalization'] || 'No AI - use as provided',
  utmCampaign: input['UTM Campaign'] || input.utmCampaign || '',
  utmMedium: input['UTM Medium'] || 'email',
  createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  status: 'draft'
};

// Determine if immediate send
campaign.sendNow = campaign.sendTime === 'Send Now';

return { json: campaign };

options.systemMessage: You are an email marketing expert specializing in high-converting campaigns. Focus on subject lines that drive opens and content that drives clicks. Be data-driven and specific.
